H1_mediator_bidirectional.name: tension_link as true bidirectional mediator
H1_mediator_bidirectional.claim: tension_link is genuine information channel between CLM and EEG; both directions carry > random information
H1_mediator_bidirectional.predicted_signature: P2 TE both directions significantly > bootstrap null (p<0.05)
H1_mediator_bidirectional.rationale_promising: consistent with W4 PARTIAL (active L1 +2.28σ vs random) AND N-1 BRIDGE B1-B3 PASS
H1_mediator_bidirectional.rationale_demoting: no direct CLM-EEG wire — bidirectional must include user cognitive mediator, which inflates apparent coupling
H1_mediator_bidirectional.falsifier: if both TE = 0 in P2 → H1 reject

H2_one_way_only.name: unidirectional mediator (CLM→user→EEG only)
H2_one_way_only.claim: mediator carries information one direction (CLM output drives user cognition drives EEG α modulation); reverse path is open-loop because no closed CLM-EEG sensor wire
H2_one_way_only.predicted_signature: P2 TE_clm_to_eeg > 0 sig; TE_eeg_to_clm ≈ 0 OR equals control (typing-only)
H2_one_way_only.rationale_promising: matches physical reality — CLM has no EEG sensor input; user typing-mediated reverse path is conflated with user-only cognitive process; aligns with N-1 B4 collapse (B4 needed real CLM Kuramoto driver but only synthetic was available — substrate-level closed loop missing)
H2_one_way_only.rationale_demoting: Bayesian-friendly priors but ignores bridge_v1.json B4 PASS (synthetic) which suggests reverse-path numeric correspondence at math-only level
H2_one_way_only.falsifier: if P2 shows TE_eeg_to_clm > TE_control_typing_only → H2 reject

H3_no_real_link.name: tension_link is anima-internal only; EEG correlation is artifact
H3_no_real_link.claim: mind.tension and tension_bridge 5-channel are pure substrate-internal dynamics with zero real coupling to EEG; W4 PARTIAL was random fluctuation at +2.28σ (not strong evidence)
H3_no_real_link.predicted_signature: P5 mutual information ≈ chance; P1 cross-correlation indistinguishable from shuffled null
H3_no_real_link.rationale_promising: honest baseline — W4 active_L1 was ONLY 7.06/16 (PARTIAL, not PASS); +2.28σ is weak by neuroscience standards (often 3σ minimum); current data does not distinguish from H3
H3_no_real_link.rationale_demoting: N-1 B1 EEG PLV PASS at real-EEG (452 vs 300 floor) suggests at least one side carries real signal
H3_no_real_link.falsifier: if P5 MI > 0.5 bits AND P2 TE > null → H3 reject

H4_user_artifact.name: P2 signal is user cognitive baseline (CLM contribution = 0)
H4_user_artifact.claim: any apparent CLM-EEG coupling is attributable to user cognition variability (typing patterns, attention drift, eye movement); CLM neither contributes nor responds
H4_user_artifact.predicted_signature: P3.B control (user reads pre-recorded text without CLM) shows IDENTICAL EEG α-ERD pattern as P3.A (with CLM)
H4_user_artifact.rationale_promising: user is acknowledged mediator; user-only confound is real and matches single-subject N=1 design weakness
H4_user_artifact.rationale_demoting: if CLM tension peaks PREDICT EEG response trial-by-trial above user-baseline variance, H4 reject
H4_user_artifact.falsifier: if P3.A vs P3.B paired t-test shows CLM-condition > control-condition (p<0.05) → H4 reject
